primary_task.name: Condition-Dependent Binary LLPS Classification
primary_task.description: Predict whether a protein sequence undergoes liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) under specific environmental conditions (concentration, salt, pH, temperature). This avoids the noise in experimental solute concentration as a proxy for C_sat.

targets.llps_binary: Binary LLPS status (1: underwent LLPS, 0: did not undergo LLPS)

secondary_task.name: Condition-Dependent Saturation Boundary Interpolation
secondary_task.description: Predict the critical saturation concentration (C_sat) threshold by interpolating the binary LLPS decision boundary where P(LLPS) = 0.5. C_sat regression is demoted to an illustrative output excluded from the benchmark verdict.

bootstrap_ci.method: Non-parametric cluster block bootstrap resampling of pairwise model differences (resampling families/clusters, not rows), ensuring the evaluation harness is identical to the power simulation.

part_1_extrapolation_margin.requirement: The 95% bootstrap confidence interval of the pairwise difference delta (AUPRC_DEQ - AUPRC_best_baseline) on the out-of-condition extrapolation test set (using cluster block-bootstrap resampling sequence families) must have a lower bound strictly greater than 0, with a median difference >= 0.05, consistently across all 5 seeds. This pairwise difference CI resolves the statistical power issue of overlapping independent CIs on small test sets.

power_audits.statement: A null result cannot distinguish 'no effect' from 'true effect < ~0.06'.
power_audits.variance_assumption: σ_family = 0.10 is provisional and will be re-checked against the empirical per-family variance once baselines exist.

part_2_indistribution_performance.requirement: DEQ must match or beat the best baseline in-distribution (AUPRC difference 95% CI lower bound >= 0).

part_3_memory_efficiency.requirement: DEQ's O(1) memory footprint (constant peak VRAM usage during training and inference relative to effective depth) must be quantified and confirmed on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU.

null_result_policy.policy: If any part of the 3-part win condition is not satisfied, the null result will be reported honestly. No post-hoc hyperparameter tuning, model retuning against the locked-test, or modification of the frozen data splits is permitted.

known_limitations_and_confounders.salt_reentrance: Many LLPS proteins (e.g. FUS) exhibit non-monotonic (reentrant) phase behavior, separating at both low and high salt but not intermediate. Extrapolating from low-salt to high-salt might violate this physics, which we note as a physical confounder for the extrapolation gap.
